pages.title: Silkmoth
pages.text: In the years when the astral plague raged, even moonlight became dangerous. Predators circled the night sky, hunting any creature that dared cast a shadow in the dark.

pages.title: Attributes
pages.text: $(li)Hold the jump key to ascend slowly$(li)Release to drift gently down on the wind$(li)Immune to fall damage$(br)Under the open daytime sky:$(li)Movement speed -0.05$(li)Max health -4$(br)Under the open night sky:$(li)Movement speed +0.05$(li)Max health +4$(br)Neither applies while in darkness.

pages.title: Tale
pages.text: Legend tells of a brood of silkmoths that fed on moon-dew and mulberry leaves, their silk glowing faintly in the night. As the predators circled above day and night, they learned to ride the wind — rising in silence, drifting down without a sound, never a wingbeat seen in their ascent, never a rustle heard in their fall. $(br)To the predators, the night sky was dead silence; and within that silence, they hid.
